body:
> Just a suggestion. Instead of updating the url on every keystroke, why not use the urlSync.threshold parameter to affect the url updating time too?

It's tricky, because then you have an interface that gets updated at every keystroke but the url itself is only updated after 700ms, which results in a visual distraction if you already started reading the webpage (we tried it, not convincing).

Can I ask you the reason for using the hash instead of the url? Ultimately I think we will remove the hash option because it causes too much issues.
